title: Deviation & CAPA Intelligence
short: Finds the patterns hidden across hundreds of deviation reports and helps QA write stronger investigations.
symptom: The same deviations keep coming back
ingredient: A pattern finder for deviation and CAPA records
directions: Feed in past deviation reports. See recurring root causes, similar past cases and a draft investigation for QA to complete.
problem: Deviations are investigated one at a time, so recurring root causes across lines, products and shifts are easy to miss.
why: Repeat deviations mean weak CAPAs, batch losses and inspection findings.
solution: Classifies deviations, links each new one to similar past cases and their CAPAs, highlights recurring causes, and drafts an investigation outline that QA reviews and approves.
limitations: Requires validated, access-controlled systems (GMP data integrity)
Drafts support QA; they never close a deviation
data: Product, line, equipment and shift metadata
review: QA classifies, investigates and approves every deviation and CAPA in the validated quality system.
